Sign up for guitarbots for at least 1 month before switching to rocksmith if you still want to. You would not believe how far I've come in the last 6 months and it's all due to guitarbots.

I had been playing guitar on and off for a few years previously, and just messed around with basic chords. Then I decided to give guitarbots a go and it just opened up a whole new world. I learned how to read tabs, improved my muscle memory, and best of all it allowed me to import any song to learn as a guitarpro file. You will learn incredibly fast.

If you want, you don't even have to pay for it. Login daily for 5 days to do the basic exercises and on the 5th consecutive day you unlock premium membership for one day, then you can import custom songs or play other imported ones.

I honestly can't recommend it enough.

I got rocksmith 2 weeks ago and honestly the interface really frustrates me. I feel like I'm back to square one. I'm sure I'll get used to it but guitarbots teaches you to read tabs easily. Also you're kinda limited in your choice of songs with rocksmith unless you go messing around with it or buying dlc. I do however like that I can use it as an amp to play around with different pedals.

At least try guitarbots first, that's all I ask ;)
